name: io.github.modelcontextprotocol/servers
title: Filesystem
description: Read, write, and manage local files and directories within user-configured allowed paths.

toolsSummary.name: read_file
toolsSummary.description: Read the complete contents of a file as text (deprecated: use read_text_file).

toolsSummary.name: read_text_file
toolsSummary.description: Read the complete contents of a file as text, with options for head or tail.

toolsSummary.name: read_media_file
toolsSummary.description: Read an image or audio file as base64 encoded data with MIME type.

toolsSummary.name: read_multiple_files
toolsSummary.description: Read the contents of multiple files simultaneously.

toolsSummary.name: write_file
toolsSummary.description: Create or overwrite a file with new text content.

toolsSummary.name: edit_file
toolsSummary.description: Make line-based edits to a text file with replacements.

toolsSummary.name: create_directory
toolsSummary.description: Create a new directory, including nested paths.

toolsSummary.name: list_directory
toolsSummary.description: List all files and directories in a path with [FILE] and [DIR] prefixes.

toolsSummary.name: list_directory_with_sizes
toolsSummary.description: List files and directories in a path, including sizes, sorted by name or size.

toolsSummary.name: directory_tree
toolsSummary.description: Get a recursive JSON tree view of files and directories.

toolsSummary.name: move_file
toolsSummary.description: Move or rename files and directories to a new location.

toolsSummary.name: search_files
toolsSummary.description: Recursively search for files matching a glob pattern.

toolsSummary.name: get_file_info
toolsSummary.description: Retrieve metadata like size, times, and permissions for a file or directory.

toolsSummary.name: list_allowed_directories
toolsSummary.description: List the directories this server is allowed to access.

io.sami/gallery.about: Provides secure access to the local filesystem for AI agents: read and write files, manage directories, search content, and retrieve metadata — all confined to user-specified allowed directories.

environmentVariables.name: allowed_directories
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated list of allowed directories the server can access
